focus: First v2 release failure modes: detection, rollback, prevention; Codex .agents/plugins/marketplace.json path; rollback by version number; staging before publish; concurrency

findings.title: PRD E25 contradicts verified, already-shipped Codex plugin install; ADR-0011/0013 are right, PRD is wrong
findings.claim: PRD-v2.md:179 (E25) states 'Codex installs as a plain config.toml MCP entry, not a Codex plugin (plugin spawns in cache dir, no ${VAR} expansion)'. This is the opposite of what ADR-0011 and ADR-0013 design around (codex plugin marketplace add/upgrade), and the opposite of what is already true in v1 and live-verified in spike S0.
findings.evidence: Git archaeology on cm-main: commits feat/codex-plugin and 10+ hardening fixes already shipped in v1 — 98d239b7 'fix(codex): resolve plugin-manager root for doctor and upgrade (#771)', ec48166e/7366c075 'dedupe plugin-owned context-mode hooks (#746)', e939b9a5 'guard plugin install paths from Codex Desktop transcripts (#733)', 4ba92057 'document Windows plugin symlink workaround (#730)', a90d399c 'set platform env for plugin MCP server (#722)', 572d451f/c9b8f786 'harden plugin hook routing (#575)'. Current v1 README.md:593 already tells users to run 'codex plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode' as the primary install path, with config.toml (README.md:643) only as a secondary/manual option. tickets/spike-*.md section 3 'Codex live test (CLI 0.156.1)': 'codex plugin marketplace add ... --ref release worked... New commit with version 0.0.2, then codex plugin marketplace upgrade: Upgraded 1. The cache moved to 0.0.2/ with no manual re-add' — i.e. plugin mode is VERIFIED LIVE, not a spike guess.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: feat/codex-plugin branch, merged via multiple commits (5ab1eb43 'make codex plugin self contained', 632300ca 'Use global runtime for Codex plugin'), hardened over #575, #722, #730, #733, #746, #771. ORIGINAL_INTENT (98d239b7): 'resolve plugin-manager root for doctor and upgrade' — the plugin path was deliberately made the doctor/upgrade-aware install surface, not a stopgap. REGRESSION_RISK: if v2 follows PRD E25 and drops the Codex plugin manifest in favor of a plain config.toml MCP entry, every existing v1 Codex user who installed via the plugin path loses auto-upgrade (`codex plugin marketplace upgrade`) and must be migrated by hand — this re-breaks the exact set of issues #575/#722/#730/#733/#746/#771 already fixed. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: keep `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` + `.codex-plugin/mcp.json` as the shipped artifact (matches ADR-0011/0013 already); fix PRD E25's text, not the ADRs; if E25's ${VAR}-expansion concern is real, it is an argument for a specific mcp.json syntax inside the plugin, not for abandoning the plugin.
findings.fix: Correct PRD-v2.md:179 (E25) to match ADR-0011 and the verified spike result: Codex installs and auto-updates as a plugin via the marketplace (`.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `--ref release`). If `${VAR}` expansion is genuinely unsupported inside the plugin's mcp.json, document that as a narrower constraint on the plugin's MCP config, not as a reason to drop the plugin entirely. This closes the PRD-vs-ADR contradiction that r3 (BOTTLENECKS-r3.md #50-52) correctly flagged as unresolved, and resolves it in the opposite direction from what r3's 'pick the one already tested' hint implied toward E25 — the archaeology shows the plugin path, not config.toml, is the one with years of fixes and live verification behind it.

findings.title: release.yml plan/publish/smoke job table (ADR-0013) still has no concurrency guard and no staging-before-publish step, after two rounds of flagging it
findings.claim: ADR-0013's current 'Release steps' job table (ci -> plan -> build -> publish -> smoke) still runs smoke strictly after publish, and still defines no `concurrency:` block for release.yml, exactly as last read in this pass of the live doc.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/adr/0013-release-automation.md job table: 'publish' commits to release and tags, then 'smoke' runs clean-HOME installs from @release — publish precedes smoke in the table with no staging ref step between them, and no concurrency key appears anywhere in the ADR text I read this round.
findings.archaeology: Already raised with the same evidence in RELEASE-AND-MIGRATION-r2.md items #3/#4 and carried into BOTTLENECKS-r3.md lines 70/73. DECISIONS-r3.md (Q1-Q19, the owner's accepted r3 answers) does not mention staging or concurrency, so neither fix was accepted or rejected — it is simply still open in the doc, unlike the Q1-Q19 items which the owner settled.
findings.fix: Not a new finding by itself (do not re-litigate); flagged here only to confirm status: still unresolved in the current doc text as of this round, and still outside the scope of what DECISIONS-r3.md settled. Needs an owner decision, not another review pass, since two prior rounds already specified the exact fix (concurrency: {group: release}; push a staging ref, smoke it, fast-forward release).
